notes: Fixes assigning and revoking admin user roles on Sanctum SPA installs.
changed: Assigning or revoking a user role now sends the Laravel Sanctum CSRF token, so those actions no longer fail with CSRF token mismatch.
The Next.js /api proxy forwards X-XSRF-TOKEN from the XSRF-TOKEN cookie and preserves all Set-Cookie headers from Laravel.
Revoking a role no longer errors with "No primary key defined on model" (UserRole uses a composite userId + roleId key).
